pairs.question: Walk me through how a customer message moves through W Chats.
pairs.reference_answer: The FastAPI control plane never does work inline. Anything long-running goes to Celery across two queues. `pipeline` carries ingestion, embedding and staleness, and `runtime` carries agent turns, evals, red team and the validators. A task publishes to the Redis channel `job_events:{job_id}`, the SSE endpoint subscribes, and a `job_events` table keeps the stream for late-join replay. Retrieval fuses pgvector cosine search with BM25 over native `tsvector` and `ts_rank_cd` in one SQL CTE, reranks the fused candidates, and reads a `verified_qa` cache first.

pairs.question: If I cloned W Chats this afternoon, what would I have to run to see it working and see the tests pass?
pairs.reference_answer: W Chats runs as local processes and there is no Docker path. Start `redis-server`, then `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` from `apps/api`, then `celery -A app.worker.celery_app worker -Q pipeline` and `celery -A app.worker.celery_app worker -Q runtime`, and `pnpm dev` from `apps/admin`. For the backend, `uv sync --extra dev --extra pipeline` then `.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/gates.py full`. The console and the widget run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`, `pnpm run test:unit`, `pnpm run test:e2e`, and `pnpm run build && node scripts/check-size.mjs` at 20480 bytes gzipped or less.
